precios.ctaTitulo: See the right level with your own data
precios.ctaTexto: Tell us your number of units, how you manage bookings today and what material is ready. We will return a fixed scope.

alta.titulo: From zero to selling, in an afternoon
alta.texto: Send us your photos, your accommodation types and your rates, and we set up your instance. Your own database, your domain, your brand —isolated from any other campsite. No endless projects.

items.q: What exactly is included in the €49 Start plan?
items.a: A responsive website with your brand, hosting, HTTPS, basic SEO, one language and a form that sends each enquiry to reception's email. It does not include the manager, booking engine or enquiry history; it is the first step and requires a 12-month commitment.

items.q: Do I have to change my domain?
items.a: No. Your site lives on your own domain, with your brand. We put the engine underneath.

items.q: What if I already use Booking?
items.a: You can keep it. Direct booking from your site saves you the commission on every reservation that comes in on your own; many campsites use both.

items.q: Is it hard for my receptionist?
items.a: It's designed for her: large screens, clear text, keyboard focus, and a planner you understand at a glance. No 200-page manual.
Each campsite has its own isolated database on Cloudflare's network. No other client can see your bookings.

items.q: How soon do I have it?
items.a: It depends on the level and on having the material ready. Before starting we agree the scope, content and launch date; Start has a contained onboarding process, while Management requires inventory, rates and operations to be configured.
